primary.title: Capital Gains Tax: How stocks, ETFs and equity mutual funds are taxed now
primary.summary: For equity mutual funds, exchange-traded funds and stocks, the holding period required to qualify as a long-term investment is more than 12 months. STCG on these assets is taxed at 20%, while LTCG is taxed at 12.5% on gains exceeding the applicable annual exemption threshold.
